subject.title: feat(ci): weekly Codex sweep for date-carrying to-dos

question: Should OpenClaw enable this recurring Codex workflow to transform repository text into a validated report that can drive GitHub App issue updates?
rationale: The branch deliberately adds a persistent secret-backed automation and privileged publication boundary; accepting its operational and security tradeoff requires repository-owner intent beyond a normal code-correctness review.

options.title: Require boundary review and live dispatch proof
options.body: Confirm the validator and cross-job artifact handling, then require redacted evidence of dry-run and publication behavior before merge.

options.title: Accept the operational boundary
options.body: Approve the scheduled issue-management automation after explicitly accepting its model-backed maintenance and GitHub App trust model.

options.title: Pause the automation
options.body: Keep date scanning manual or deterministic-only until maintainers want a recurring model-backed issue publisher.

recommendation.title: Require boundary review and live dispatch proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the validator and cross-job artifact handling, then require redacted evidence of dry-run and publication behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the complete workflow and is the strongest available routing candidate for its intended operational model.
